{{Quote|I've never seen a shield like it! As long as the lead ship generates it, were utterly defenseless!|A sergeant comments on the ships shielding|<ref name="Inside Job">{{TCWComicCite|6.1|Inside Job}}</ref>}}
A '''starship''' carrying a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] capable of shielding an entire fleet of [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between them and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The ship was deployed during a [[Battle of Gall (Clone Wars)|battle]] fought on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gall/Legends|Gall]], where it shielded the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] invading the moon. Gall's [[Gall planetary defense force|planetary defense force]] attempted to shoot down the Separatist landing craft but could not penetrate the shield produced by the lead craft, although the Separatists could shoot out from within it at the defenders. A [[Unidentified Gall sergeant|sergeant]] serving in the defense force informed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] of the shielding and the pair used agricultural vehicles known as [[jet-wing]]s to fly through the lead craft's shielding without being detected by its [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Skywalker and Tano landed successfully on the craft and entered through a hatch on its exterior. They then made their way through several rooms filled with inactive [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s before reaching the shield generator, which they commented looked similar to technology designed by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], although far more advanced. They then planted explosives on the generator, triggering the activation of the droid forces onboard. The pair fought against the attacking B1 battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], but were far outnumbered and used their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] to carve through the flooring of the ship and drop to safety in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] which were waiting below. The explosives then detonated, destroying the ship and lowering the shields covering the rest of the landing craft and allowing the defense force to destroy them.

==Behind the scenes==
The shielded craft first appeared, but wasn't named, in ''[[Inside Job]]'' a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] written by [[Rik Hoskin]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]], which was published in [[2009]] in issue [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.1|6.1]] of the [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars Comic UK'']] magazine series.
